title: Hurghada airport transfer times by resort area 2026
body_markdown:
Transfer time from Hurghada International Airport (HRG) to your hotel runs anywhere from 15 minutes to over an hour, and the resort belt you're staying in decides almost all of that variance. Hurghada City and Sahl Hasheesh sit closest to the runway; Soma Bay and Safaga sit furthest south down the coastal highway.


**TL;DR**

- Hurghada airport transfer time averages about 40 minutes across the six main resort belts in 2026.
- Hurghada City is fastest at 15-20 minutes; Safaga is slowest at 65-75 minutes.
- El Gouna and Sahl Hasheesh both sit in the 25-35 minute band despite being in opposite directions from HRG.
- A private transfer beats a shared shuttle on time for every resort area past Makadi Bay.


## Why this matters

Hotels quote pickup windows, not drive times, so travelers land with no idea whether their ride is 20 minutes or 75. That gap matters most on late arrivals, when a longer Safaga or Soma Bay run means a hotel check-in well past midnight.

Knowing the real number before you land also changes how you book. If you're staying in Makadi Bay or further south, a [private transfer](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/how-to-plan-a-private-transfer-from-hurghada-airport) booked with a fixed pickup time is worth the extra planning over a shared shuttle that stops at four other hotels first.

## Hurghada airport transfer time by resort area (2026)

The table below lists typical one-way private transfer times from Hurghada International Airport to each major resort belt, based on standard road distances along the Red Sea coastal highway and normal daytime traffic conditions in 2026.

| Resort area | Distance from HRG | Typical transfer time |
|---|---|---|
| Hurghada City / Downtown | ~8 km | 15-20 min |
| El Gouna | ~22 km | 25-35 min |
| Sahl Hasheesh | ~20 km | 25-30 min |
| Makadi Bay | ~30 km | 35-40 min |
| Soma Bay | ~48 km | 55-60 min |
| Safaga | ~58 km | 65-75 min |
| **All areas average** | — | **~40 min** |

**Hurghada City leads at 15-20 minutes; Safaga trails at 65-75 minutes** — nearly a four-fold difference between the two ends of the resort belt. El Gouna and Sahl Hasheesh land almost identically despite sitting in opposite directions from the airport, one north and one south, which surprises a lot of first-time visitors who assume north-south always means longer.

Makadi Bay sits close to the overall average, making it a reasonable middle reference point: book roughly 40 minutes and you'll rarely be wrong. Anything south of Makadi Bay — Soma Bay, Safaga — pushes well past that average and deserves its own buffer.

The order below moves from closest to farthest resort belt as measured from Hurghada International Airport, which is the same order the table above uses.


![Vertical timeline ranking six Hurghada resort areas from closest to farthest from the airport](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/14b5cfee-7d16-48b0-88d4-ae8ca132e07f/body-c61016a5066cce43bc9cd853301f7b4f.jpg)

*Sahl Hasheesh and El Gouna land in nearly the same time band despite sitting in opposite directions from the airport.*


### Where the shuttle differs from a private transfer

A [private transfer from Hurghada Airport to El Gouna](https://dailyredsea.com/blog/private-transfers-from-hurghada-airport-to-el-gouna) runs a direct route with one stop: your hotel. A shared shuttle covering the same distance often adds three or four other drop-offs before yours, which can turn a 30-minute drive into 60-90 minutes door to door.

That gap widens the further south you go. A [private transfer to Makadi Bay](https://dailyredsea.com/blog/private-transfers-from-hurghada-airport-to-makadi-bay) stays close to the 35-40 minute table figure because there's no detour. The same trip on a multi-stop shuttle can easily double, especially during peak arrival windows when the coastal highway sees more traffic near the airport roundabout.

**Methodology:** figures reflect standard road distances between Hurghada International Airport and each named resort belt on the Red Sea coastal highway, under typical daytime traffic in 2026. **Limitation:** these are point-to-point drive estimates, not logged pickup-to-drop-off times, and they don't account for multi-hotel shared shuttle routing, checkpoint delays, or holiday traffic spikes around Christmas, New Year, or Eid.

### How to use these benchmarks

- **Book a private transfer, not a shuttle, for anything past Makadi Bay.** The time savings compound the further south the hotel sits.
- **Add a 15-20 minute buffer for night arrivals.** Traffic is lighter but pickup coordination at the terminal takes longer after dark.
- **Use the 40-minute average as your default expectation**, then adjust up for Soma Bay and Safaga, down for Hurghada City and Sahl Hasheesh.
- **Confirm your resort belt, not just "Hurghada,"** when booking — the difference between El Gouna and Safaga is nearly an hour.



Daily Red Sea runs private airport transfers across every resort belt in this table, with pickup timed to your flight rather than a shared shuttle window. If your hotel sits in [Sahl Hasheesh](https://dailyredsea.com/blog/private-transfers-from-hurghada-airport-to-sahl-hasheesh), the drive is short enough that a private car and a shared shuttle land within minutes of each other — the value of a private transfer shows up more on the longer southern runs.

## FAQ


**What is the average Hurghada airport transfer time in 2026?**

The average is about 40 minutes across the six main resort belts, from Hurghada City at 15-20 minutes up to Safaga at 65-75 minutes. Your actual time depends entirely on which resort area you're staying in.

**How long is the transfer from Hurghada Airport to El Gouna?**

El Gouna sits roughly 22 km from Hurghada International Airport, a private transfer of 25-35 minutes. A shared shuttle with multiple stops can run longer.

**How far is Safaga from Hurghada Airport?**

Safaga is about 58 km south of the airport, the longest transfer in the resort belt at 65-75 minutes by private car. Book extra buffer time if your flight lands late.

**How long does it take to get to Makadi Bay from Hurghada Airport?**

Makadi Bay is about 30 km from HRG, a 35-40 minute private transfer. It sits close to the overall resort-belt average of 40 minutes.

**Is a private or shared shuttle transfer faster from Hurghada Airport?**

A private transfer is faster for every resort area past Makadi Bay because it runs a direct route to one hotel. A shared shuttle stops at three or four other hotels first, which can double the drive time.

**Is Sahl Hasheesh close to Hurghada Airport?**

Yes, Sahl Hasheesh is about 20 km from the airport, a 25-30 minute private transfer, one of the shortest runs in the resort belt.

**What time should I book a Hurghada airport transfer for a night flight?**

Add 15-20 minutes to the daytime estimate for coordination at the terminal after dark. Traffic itself is usually lighter at night, which offsets some of that extra time.

**Do Hurghada airport transfer times change during holidays?**

Yes, traffic near the airport and along the coastal highway increases during Christmas, New Year, and Eid, adding to the standard drive times listed above. Book pickup with extra buffer during those periods.


## One last thing

The biggest surprise in this data isn't Safaga being slow — it's that El Gouna and Sahl Hasheesh, sitting in opposite directions from the airport, land in almost the same time band. Don't assume north or south automatically means shorter; check the actual resort belt, not the compass direction, before you set expectations for pickup.
